gittree.config.title: GitTree
gittree.config.gitPath.description: Path to the git executable. Falls back to the built-in `git.path` setting, then PATH, then well-known install locations.
gittree.config.trace.description: Log every git invocation (argv, duration, exit code — never file contents) to the "GitTree" output channel, and reveal debug commands.
gittree.config.mode.description: How GitTree coexists with the built-in Git extension. "auto" asks once per workspace; "takeover" disables the built-in Git here (writes `git.enabled: false`); "companion" runs alongside it without overlapping decorations.
gittree.config.mode.takeover: GitTree provides all SCM UI; the built-in Git extension is disabled for this workspace.
gittree.config.mode.companion: GitTree runs alongside the built-in Git extension; overlapping gutter/explorer decorations stay off.
gittree.config.terminalAuth.description: Export GitTree's git credential helper (GIT_ASKPASS) into integrated terminals so command-line git prompts are answered by VS Code.

gittree.config.scm.title: GitTree Source Control
gittree.config.quickDiff.base.descriptio: What the editor gutter bars compare against: the index (IntelliJ behavior — bars show unstaged edits) or HEAD (bars show all uncommitted edits).
gittree.config.autofetch.enabled.descrip: Periodically run `git fetch` in the background so incoming/outgoing counts stay fresh.
gittree.config.localHistory.title: GitTree Local History
gittree.config.localHistory.enabled.desc: Record Local History snapshots around destructive git operations (the failsafe for reset --hard, rebase, checkout over dirty files, …).
gittree.config.localHistory.maxSizeMb.de: Storage budget for Local History blobs. Oldest snapshots are garbage-collected first when over budget.
gittree.config.localHistory.retentionDay: Snapshots older than this are garbage-collected (the most recent snapshot is always kept).
gittree.config.localHistory.maxFileSizeK: Files larger than this are recorded as metadata-only stubs instead of full content.
gittree.config.localHistory.snapshotOnSa: Also record a snapshot on file save (debounced 30s per file). Off by default — VS Code's native Local History already covers saves.
gittree.config.localHistory.taskLabels.d: Record a labeled snapshot when a build/test task finishes, so states like "after the last green test run" are easy to find.
